init_entries: initialize the DCI dataset entry maps from a source directory for global access
get_dci_count: get the total number of densely captioned images loaded in the entry map
load_image: load a DCI image and its associated mask data from a JSON file by entry key
DenseCaptionedImage_get_positive_mask_sa: get cropped subimage samples with captions filtered by minimum mask size and caption length
DenseCaptionedImage_get_formatted_comple: get a complete image description combining short caption, extra caption, and all mask captions
